Senses.PreferredTarget: a separate transmission outside the teachings
AlternateTargets: a special transmission apart from the scriptural teachings
Senses.Explanation: (教) = the scriptural or recorded teachings, (外) = outside/apart from, (別傳) = a separate transmission. The corpus glosses its own terms. Yunmen names (教) as the canon: (三乘十二分教豈是無言語)。(因什麼更道教外別傳) ('the three vehicles and the twelvefold teachings are hardly wordless -- why then go on to speak of a separate transmission outside the teachings?', T51n2076). (中峰廣錄) (Zhongfeng's extensive record) defines the phrase directly: (言說文字等乃教也)。(離言說文字等乃教外別傳也) ('speech and letters are the teachings; apart from speech and letters is the separate transmission outside the teachings') and (所云教外別傳者)。(即超出言象而妙契此心者也) ('what is called the separate transmission outside the teachings is precisely what goes beyond words and images and wondrously accords with this mind'); it names the referent -- (教外別傳者目之為禪)。(此禪即一心之異名) ('what is called the separate transmission outside the teachings is termed Chan; this Chan is another name for the one mind') -- and derives the label: (禪不依一切經法所詮)。(不依一切修證所得)。(不依一切見聞所解)。(不依一切門路所入)。(所以云教外別傳者也) ('Chan does not rest on what any scripture expounds, on what any refining and verifying obtains, on what any seeing-and-hearing understands, or on any gateway of entry -- therefore it is called the separate transmission outside the teachings'; all B25n0145; 教外別傳者 10 hits / 6 files). (古尊宿語錄) (the Recorded Sayings of the Ancient Worthies) has (所謂教外別傳者蓋取其要妙也) ('what is called the separate transmission outside the teachings is so called for its essential subtlety', C077n1710). The charter scene is the Flower Sermon (世尊在靈山會上。拈華示眾。是時眾皆默然。唯迦葉尊者破顏微笑 -- 'the World-Honored One, at the assembly on Vulture Peak, held up a flower and showed it to the assembly; the whole assembly was silent; only the venerable Kasyapa broke into a smile'), where the (正法眼藏) ('treasury of the true eye of the teaching') passes (不立文字)。(教外別傳)。(付囑摩訶迦葉) ('not setting up words -- a separate transmission outside the teachings -- entrusted to Mahakasyapa', X80n1565). Attested deployment: (a) the slogan -- adjacent to (不立文字) ('not setting up words') in 48 hits / 42 files (order reversed, 38 / 31), in the four-phrase frame with (直指人心) ('directly pointing at the human mind') / (見性成佛) ('seeing nature, becoming buddha'), the Blue Cliff Record variant carrying (單傳心印) ('the single transmission of the mind-seal'; 79 / 34); (b) a fixed test-question -- (如何是教外別傳) ('what is the separate transmission outside the teachings?'; 70 hits / 36 files), with the tails (一句) ('the one phrase of', 63 / 30), (底事) ('the matter of', 20 / 15), (底法) ('the teaching of', 7 / 6), (之旨) ('the purport of', 73 / 52) and the probe (別傳箇)/(個什麼) ('separately transmit WHAT?'; 13 files); recorded answers include Gushan's (喫茶去) ('go drink tea') and Shishuang's (非句) ('a non-phrase'); (c) Yunmen's question quoted above, asked of the phrase itself. B25n0145 also records an objection -- (豈教外果別有未盡之法為傳耶)。(儻別有所傳則名外道) ('is there really, outside the teachings, some further teaching left unexhausted to transmit? if something were separately transmitted, it would be called an outside way') -- and answers it in the same passage (茲復謂議者曰, 'then again he says to the objectors'), where the (言說文字) ('speech and letters') definition above appears together with (所云別傳者)。(非教外別有所謂禪也)。(非心外別有所謂法也) ('what is called separately transmitted is not that outside the teachings there is some separate thing called Chan, nor that outside the mind there is some separate thing called a teaching').
Senses.Note: 640 hits across 211 files of the 462-file allowlist (XML tags/notes/rdg stripped, whitespace collapsed, punctuation retained -- all counts in this entry use this convention). Two attested facets -- the four-phrase slogan and the test-question (如何是教外別傳) ('what is the separate transmission outside the teachings?') -- each appear across many independent masters and files. Curated occurrences span the founding legend in the (五燈會元) (Compendium of the Five Lamps), the (碧巖錄) (Blue Cliff Record), the (景德傳燈錄) (Jingde-era Lamp Record; Yunmen, Gushan), and the (古尊宿語錄) (Recorded Sayings of the Ancient Worthies; Shishuang). ewk's 'outside the historical records' rendering is rejected against the Chinese, where the texts themselves gloss (教) as the scriptural teachings: (三乘十二分教) ('the three vehicles and the twelvefold teachings', T51n2076) and (言說文字等乃教也) ('speech and letters are the teachings', B25n0145).

Occurrences.Kwic: 正法眼藏。涅槃妙心。實相無相。微妙法門。不立文字。教外別傳。付囑摩訶迦葉。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), Shakyamuni Buddha section. Shakyamuni Buddha is the exact speaker: after Mahakasyapa alone smiles when the flower is raised, Shakyamuni Buddha names the treasury of the true eye of the teaching, the wondrous mind of nirvana, the subtle gate not established in words, and the separate transmission outside the teachings, then entrusts it to Mahakasyapa. Mahakasyapa is the sole smiling responder and recipient, not the speaker.

Occurrences.Kwic: 謂之教外別傳。單傳心印。直指人心。見性成佛。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Blue Cliff Record: this is called a separate transmission outside the teachings, the single transmission of the mind-seal, directly pointing at the human mind, seeing nature and becoming Buddha.

Occurrences.Kwic: 三乘十二分教豈是無言語。因什麼更道教外別傳。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Yunmen's question about the phrase itself: the three vehicles and the twelvefold canon are hardly wordless -- why then go on to speak of a 'separate transmission outside the teachings'?

Occurrences.Kwic: 如何是教外別傳底事。師曰。喫茶去。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The test-question form (如何是教外別傳底事, 'what is the matter of the separate transmission outside the teachings?'); Gushan's recorded answer: (喫茶去) ('go drink tea').

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問如何是教外別傳一句霜云非句
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄): in a case raised and commented on by Yunmen Wenyan, an unnamed monk asks Shishuang Qingzhu for the one phrase transmitted outside the teaching. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not name the unnamed monk.
